title: German RA-ILD Study Group
summary: Our registry study includes patients with rheumatic diseases and pulmonary involvement. Over a period of 6 years, we monitor the course of the disease and the medications taken. At the same time, we collect blood samples. Our goal is to identify risk factors for the development of pulmonary involvement or a poorer response to treatment.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
2. patients who meet the ACR classification criteria for rheumatoid arthritis 2010
3. written informed consent
3. ILD confirmed by CT Thorax
4. ILD diagnosis must be within 3 years prior to inclusion
All inclusion criteria must be fulfilled.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Decline/ withdrawal of consent
2. Preexisting RA-ILD longer than 3 years
3. Participants in ongoing clinical drug trials
4. Pregnancy or lactation
